notes: The report is the compiler's commentary on variant routes and gives no main isnad: every group is marked variant (rule 4) and none is a route.
«حدثنا بذلك أبو كريب عن يحيى بن آدم عن شريك» is the compiler's route to Shurayk's version, also marked variant.
«أبو يحيى هو القتات الكوفي» is the compiler's identification and «ولم يذكر فيه عن أبي يحيى» a remark on the omission: neither is a link.
